{{Otheruses|Squad Three}}
'''Squad Three''' was a squad of [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter/Legends|Alpha-3 ''Nimbus''-class V-wing starfighters]] serving in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The starfighters of the squadron were painted gray with light gray markings identifying their squad affiliation. In addition to standard features, the ships were equipped with [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] launchers.
